description: A circular blue-and-ivory tiled basin with a radial coping, a stone sphere, bronze water outlets and a drained service recess.
Three transparent windscreen bays, cantilever roof with glazing clips, timetable cabinet, and a timber passenger bench.
Compact gravity cistern with a hollow vitreous bowl, seat, push button, shutoff and flexible supply.
Two-group espresso machine with stepped cast side cheeks, portafilters, steam pipe, gauge, drip tray and cups.
